Talent0_2Ability.name: Saturated Fire
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: When both hands are equipped with Machine Gun, [Basic Attack] and <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> are upgraded to <buf ID=900150>[Twin-Gun Basic Attack]</buf> and <buf ID=900069>[Twin-Gun Link Attack]</buf>. When using Machine Gun to performs [Basic Attack] or <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> bullet hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf> after the action. Activating <buf ID=900153>[Weapon Skill]</buf> consumes corresponding number of stacks. Enters <buf ID=2020468>[Overheating]</buf> when reaches <color=#F74848>200</color> stacks.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Saturated Fire
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
When both hands are equipped with Machine Gun, [Basic Attack] and <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> are upgraded to <buf ID=900150>[Twin-Gun Basic Attack]</buf> and <buf ID=900069>[Twin-Gun Link Attack]</buf>. When using Machine Gun to performs [Basic Attack] or <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, for each <color=#F74848>1</color> bullet hit, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> stack of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf> after the action. Activating <buf ID=900153>[Weapon Skill]</buf> consumes corresponding number of stacks. Enters <buf ID=2020468>[Overheating]</buf> when reaches <color=#F74848>200</color> stacks.
Machine Gun range increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>. When using Machine Gun to activate <buf ID=900153>[Weapon Skill]</buf> with <color=#F74848>120</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, reduces <color=#F74848>1</color> PP from the target. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> times per turn.

200001.name: CEC 1
200001.SpecificEffects: In cooperation with allies, use Assault Weapons to launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2x</color> DMG, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

202002.name: Twin-Gun Reflex
202002.describe: Uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2x0.55</color> DMG. Each <color=#F74848>1</color> grants <color=#F74848>2</color> stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>. <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf> stacks are retained after combat.

202003.name: Overcharged Firepower
202003.SpecificEffects: Each stack of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf> increases DMG dealt by <color=#F74848>0.25%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>25%</color>. At the start of action, consumes <color=#F74848>10</color> stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>.

202004.name: Sudden Strike
202004.describe: Instantly gains <color=#F74848>20</color> stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, also locks the number <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf> stacks, cannot gains or consumes stacks. <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> count increases by <color=#F74848>+8</color>. This effect lasts till the start of next turn. Can continue action with full movement.

202005.name: Fighting Spirit
202005.SpecificEffects: When actively attacking, if possesses <color=#F74848>80</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, randomly gains <color=#F74848>1</color> of <buf ID=7100404>[Crit Rate UP II]</buf>, <buf ID=7100104>[Hit Rate UP II]</buf> or <buf ID=7100503>[Crit DMG UP II]</buf> before combat, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

202006.name: Intercepting Strike
202006.describe: Jumps and attacks <color=#F74848>1</color> target within <color=#F74848>2</color> adjacent tiles with two Machine Guns, dealing <color=#F74848>2x0.7</color> DMG. Then lands on an empty tile <color=#F74848>2</color> away on the opposite side of target. The target cannot launch [Retaliation] or <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>. If possesses <color=#F74848>80</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, this attack's Critical Hit chance and Critical Hit DMG are increased by <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

202007.name: Determination
202007.SpecificEffects: When activating <buf ID=900153>[Weapon Skill]</buf> with Machine Gun, if possesses <color=#F74848>120</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, consumes <color=#F74848>1</color> PP and recovers <color=#F74848>3</color> AP after combat. This effect can trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Gains <color=#F74848>2</color> PP at the start of battle.

202008.name: Vanguard Signal
202008.describe: Uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>2x0.7</color> DMG and forces all allies within range to launch <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> against the target. This <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> does not require allies to possess a specific skill and does not consume any Link times. If possesses <color=#F74848>80</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, gains <buf ID=2020082>[Focus Fire]</buf> after combat, lasting till the start of next action.

hiddenSkills.name: Precision Fire
hiddenSkills.describe: Uses a Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3x</color> DMG. When possessing <color=#F74848>80</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, Hit Rate and Critical Hit chance increase by <color=#F74848>20%</color>.

200011.name: CEC 2
200011.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s effective times per turn <color=#F74848>+1</color>.

200021.name: CEC 3
200021.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>'s damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.3</color>.

200022.name: Power Innovation 2
200022.SpecificEffects: When breaking a part, restore <color=#F74848>1</color> AP after combat, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

200031.name: Perfect Position 1
200031.SpecificEffects: Unlock the Assault Weapon's <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf> ability. When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color>.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

200034.name: Perfect Position 2
200034.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Hit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200035.name: Perfect Position 3
200035.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, Crit Rate <color=#F74848>+12%</color>.

200036.name: Perfect Position 4
200036.SpecificEffects: When in combat with a target at <buf ID=900011>[Ideal Range]</buf>, final DMG <color=#F74848>+30%</color>.

202041.name: Zone Contract 1
202041.SpecificEffects: All allies <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> DMG increases by <color=#F74848>15%</color>, and assault and ranged weapons gains <color=#F74848>+1</color> <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> count.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

202044.name: Zone Contract 2
202044.SpecificEffects: At the start of action, if possesses <color=#F74848>80</color> or more stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, Machine Gun range increases by <color=#F74848>+1</color>, lasting till the start of next action.

202045.name: Zone Contract 3
202045.SpecificEffects: <buf ID=2000011>[Zone Contract 1]</buf> grants additionally <color=#F74848>+1</color> <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> count. For each <color=#F74848>4</color> <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> triggered, gains <color=#F74848>1</color> AP.

202046.name: Zone Contract 4
202046.SpecificEffects: When attacking with Machine Guns, for each <color=#F74848>40</color> stacks of <buf ID=2020505>[Overcharged Bullet]</buf>, Final DMG dealt increases by <color=#F74848>10%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>30%</color>.
